plan.description: A classic brick breaker game built on top of the Next.js 16 Canvas2D boilerplate. The game features a paddle, a bouncing ball, destructible bricks, scoring, lives, and game-over/win overlays — all wired through the pre-baked state machine, game loop, and keyboard hooks.
